I’d fix one issue before merging.

**[P2] Only the first space is removed — `src/normalize.js:4`**
`raw.trim().replace(' ', '')` removes a single space, leaving subsequent spaces in the number. All three examples advertised in the README therefore throw `bad number` instead of queueing a message:
- `+44 20 7946 0958`
- `0044 20 7946 0958`
- `+1 (415) 555-0100`

For example, the first normalizes to `+4420 7946 0958`, which fails validation. Remove spaces globally and add an end-to-end `queueText` test covering these documented inputs; the current normalization test contains only one space, so it misses this.

Reviewed `phone-normalize` at `173e408` against `main` at `55b6c3b`. All 5 existing tests pass; the reproductions above fail. No code changed.
